class.name: WorldGround
class.brief_description: The ground contract: the deformable ground's surface, soil and what lies on it.
class.description: Read it through [method WorldContracts.get_ground]. The provider is the active [GroundSurface3D]; with none, every query returns its default (firm ground, nothing on it, the height from the first physics surface under the point). A test sets a stub with [method WorldContracts.set_ground]: a script extending this class that overrides the virtual methods it needs; the rest fall back to the real ground. See docs/ideas/world-contracts.md.

method.name: dent_at
method.description: How far the ground is pressed down at [param position] (ruts, prints), in metres. Default 0.

method.name: frost_at
method.description: The frozen ground: the thawed layer on top (m), the frost's depth (m) and how weakened a thaw has left it (0 to 1). Default zero.

method.name: has_provider
method.description: [code]true[/code] when a ground is live.

method.name: height_at
method.description: The ground's deformed surface under [param position], in metres. With no ground, the first physics surface under the point, else -INF.

method.name: ice_at
method.description: Ice on standing water: its thickness (m) and the share broken into plates. Default zero.

method.name: mud_depth_at
method.description: The depth of soft slurry over firmer soil, in metres. Default 0.

method.name: needle_ice_at
method.description: Needle ice: its height (m) and the loose crumbs its thaw left (0 to 1). Default zero.

method.name: rim_at
method.description: How far the ground is raised at [param position] (berms, laid soil), in metres. Default 0.

method.name: runoff_at
method.description: Water running over the ground: its depth (m) and speed (m/s). Default zero.

method.name: rut_guidance_at
method.description: Ruts under a tyre at [param contact]: the cross slope of the ground's deformation along [param lateral] (rising towards it), and the rut wall's height beside the tread on its -[param lateral] and +[param lateral] sides (m), for a tread [param half_width] m either side. Default zero.

method.name: soil_at
method.description: The soil: [code]soft[/code] (false for firm ground, rock or no soil), [code]cohesion[/code] (kPa), [code]friction_angle[/code] (degrees) and [code]stickiness[/code] (0 to 1, how wet clay clings). Default firm.

method.name: standing_water_at
method.description: Water standing on the ground (ruts, prints, puddles), in metres. Default 0.
